Current payroll is deliberately lower and the goal is to raise the team's pay to the quoter's figures, so the real margin on people today is higher than the quoter shows. items.known: Decided by the CEO: 45% is the margin floor of the managed services of the creative practice (2026-10-10; offer creative-managed-service, target 45, minimum 45), and 25% is the margin floor of a person sold by dedication (2026-10-11; offer talent-assurance-staffing, catalog v7), with the price rising from there case by case. Where more can be earned the target of the offer is raised, not the floor. The staff-augmentation targets by workbook tier (30% tiers 1 and 2, 35% tier 3, 40% tier 4) were proposed by the agent and confirmed by the CEO the same day; they replace the historical markup. Market factors CL 1, CO 0.90 and US 1.10 are confirmed; PE 0.95, MX 1 and ES 1.10 and every talent factor outside Chile are estimates. The 40 target / 35 floor of the readiness proposal was never approved and is not a floor

Catalog v6 adds EUR to USD 1.20 (ECB reference 1.1206) as an open-ended estimate under the same instruction; it was not explicitly decided for EUR. USD to CLF 0.024 stays an estimated 2025 value. items.required: Validation of each factor with real hires (talent) and closed or lost deals (market), and a specific cost record wherever a profile or seniority departs from its country factor
items.known: Catalog v5 holds two country axes. Talent factor on cost, relative to Chile: CL 1; CO 0.80, PE 0.85, MX 0.90, ES 3, US 5 are estimates from job postings and salary guides read on 2026-10-11, one factor per country for every profile. Market factor on the human price: CL 1, CO 0.90 and US 1.10 decided by the CEO from the workbook ranges; PE 0.95, MX 1 and ES 1.10 are estimates. In CO and PE the margin floor follows the factor (floorBasis base_market), so a quote at policy price shows about 41% and 43% real margin without being flagged. Factors by client type (SME, public tender, strategic client) exist in the workbook and are expressed today as an agreed net

items.required: Review each tool unit price by its review date, and replace it with a new policy version when a provider changes it; confirm the contracted plan where the price is a public list price
items.known: Decided by the CEO on 2026-10-11: a unit price does not expire.
